paragraphs: Life Events is a software-as-a-service system for crematorium management, cemetery management, pet funerals, and funeral homes. It is used to manage burials, cremations, pet burials, pet cremations, cemeteries, crematoria and funeral homes.

Diary and resource management is meant to make booking simple enough that new staff, funeral directors, or the public can book services the operator can always fulfil. Self-service facilities run around the clock and are pitched as bringing convenience and choice to customers while reducing staff workloads. Invoicing, receipting, payments, banking and financial reporting all sit on the same platform. Mobile applications cover asset risk inspection, mortuary tracking and shipping. Reporting generates charts, reports and exports with cross tab analysis.

The company says its engineers built the system on 24 years of experience delivering to the bereavement services industry. Operators can host their own website from within the platform. The site offers a bereavement services demonstration. The site is published by Datawing Limited.
